name: NCD0603Y2
title: 0603 surface-mount chip LED, 588 nm dominant wavelength
summary: A chip LED in the 0603 outline, 1.6 × 0.8 mm and 0.80 mm tall, with a lens on a 0.3 mm substrate. At 15 mA it emits 50 to 180 mcd (100 mcd typ) at a 583 to 595 nm dominant wavelength, peaking at 595 nm, with a forward drop of 1.5 to 2.6 V and a 130 degree viewing angle. It takes 25 mA continuous and 50 mA in short pulses, and ships 4000 to a reel on 8 mm carrier tape.

tables.title: Electro-optical characteristics
notes: Bin tolerances: luminous intensity ±15%, forward voltage ±0.1 V, colour coordinates (x, y) ±0.01, dominant wavelength ±1 nm.
The figures are for reference; where they differ from the label on the product, the label holds. NationStar's own test system measures every figure.

operation.text: Pin 1 is the cathode (-) and pin 2 the anode (+). On the top face a solder-resist stripe 0.20 mm in from the edge marks the cathode end; the emitting die sits at the centre of the body.

Parts come on 8 mm carrier tape with sprocket holes at a 4 mm pitch, 4000 to a reel. A reel starts with 200 mm of cover tape and a 100 mm empty leader, and ends with a 100 mm empty trailer. In each pocket the cathode stripe faces the sprocket holes.
